-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvMisc` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem hbCtx_recvAck (r : ReadOnly) (src : w64) (ctx : List w8) : hbCtx (readonlyRecvAck r src ctx)
    = hbCtx r

def ownReadOnly (sz : Bool) (ro : Loc) (r : ReadOnly) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rov ptrs,
      "Hro" ∷ typedPointsto ro rov (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "%Hro_conf" ∷ ⌜rov.confirmedReads' = r.confirmed⌝ ∗
          "%Hro_safe" ∷ ⌜rov.option' = W64 0⌝ ∗
            "Hacks" ∷ ownMap rov.acks' (DFrac.own 1) r.acks ∗
              "Hucr" ∷ ownSlice rov.unconfirmedReads' ptrs DFrac.discard ∗
                "Hucr_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc rov.unconfirmedReads' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  "Hreqs" ∷ [∗list] p;q ∈ ptrs;r.pending, ownReadreq sz p q)

theorem ownReadOnly_option [package_sem : Assumptions] (sz : Bool) (ro : Loc) (r : ReadOnly) : ⊢
    ownReadOnly sz ro r -∗ ∃ o, ⌜o = W64 0⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef readOnly go!"option" ro)
    o (DFrac.own 1) ∗ (typedPointsto (structFieldRef readOnly go!"option" ro) o (DFrac.own 1) -∗
    ownReadOnly sz ro r)

theorem readonlyAdd.proj_pending (r : ReadOnly) (q : ReadReq) : (readonlyAdd r q).pending =
    r.pending ++ [q]

def readStatesPts (rs : GoSlice) (sts : List ReadStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ vs,
      ownSlice rs vs DFrac.discard ∗
        [∗list] v;st ∈ vs;sts, iprop(⌜v.Index' = st.Index'⌝ ∗ ownSlice v.RequestCtx' st.RequestCtx' DFrac.discard))

theorem hbCtx_add (r : ReadOnly) (q : ReadReq) : hbCtx (readonlyAdd r q) = u64Le (readonlyPosition
    (readonlyAdd r q))

theorem readonlyAdd.proj_acks (r : ReadOnly) (q : ReadReq) : (readonlyAdd r q).acks = r.acks

theorem readStatesPts_persistent (rs : GoSlice) (sts : List ReadStateM) : Persistent (readStatesPts
    rs sts)

def ownReadreq (sz : Bool) (p : Loc) (q : ReadReq) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rv mm sn ctx rs,
      "Hrv" ∷ typedPointsto p rv DFrac.discard ∗
        "%Hrv_idx" ∷ ⌜rv.index' = q.index ∧ mm.From' = q.src ∧ mm.Type' ≠ MsgSnap⌝ ∗
          "#Hrv_msg" ∷
            msgOwnZ sz rv.req' DFrac.discard { msg := mm, ents := q.ents, snap := sn, ctx := ctx, resps := rs })

theorem readonlyAdd.proj_confirmed (r : ReadOnly) (q : ReadReq) : (readonlyAdd r q).confirmed =
    r.confirmed

theorem ownReadreq_pers (sz : Bool) (p : Loc) (q : ReadReq) : Persistent (ownReadreq sz p q)

theorem ownPendRI_pers (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (p : MessageM × List EntryM) : Persistent (ownPendRI sz
    l p)

def ownPendRI (sz : Bool) (l : Loc) (p : MessageM × List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sn ctx rs,
      msgOwnZ sz l DFrac.discard { msg := p.fst, ents := p.snd, snap := sn, ctx := ctx, resps := rs } ∗
        ⌜p.fst.Type' ≠ MsgSnap⌝)

def ownRaftMisc (sz : Bool) (readStates : GoSlice) (ro : Loc) (pendingReadIndex : GoSlice) (rd :
    RdState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("HreadStates" ∷ readStatesPts readStates rd.states ∗
      "HreadStates_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap ReadState readStates (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hro_obj" ∷ ownReadOnly sz ro rd.ro ∗
          ("Hpri" ∷ ∃ pls, ownSlice pendingReadIndex pls (DFrac.own 1) ∗ [∗list] l;p ∈ pls;rd.pend, ownPendRI sz l p) ∗
            "Hpri_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc pendingReadIndex (DFrac.own 1))

theorem readStatesPts_len [package_sem : Assumptions] (rs : GoSlice) (sts : List ReadStateM) :
    readStatesPts rs sts ⊢ ⌜sts.length = sint.nat rs.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z rs.len⌝
